context:
POST /2/articles/{article_id}/publish

name: Ensure developer account
description: Ensure developer account Creates an X Developer Platform account for the authenticated user if they do not already have one, and returns it. POST /2/account
context:
POST /2/account
Creates an X Developer Platform account for the authenticated user if they do not already have one, and returns it. Idempotent: when the user already has an account it is returned unchanged with `created` false.
Required: body (body)

name: Get developer account
description: Get developer account Returns the authenticated user's X Developer Platform account. GET /2/account
context:
GET /2/account
Returns the authenticated user's X Developer Platform account. A user without an account gets a resource-not-found error entry.

name: Get usage credits
description: Get usage credits Returns the payer's developer-platform credit balance in USD. GET /2/usage/credits
context:
GET /2/usage/credits
Returns the payer's developer-platform credit balance in USD. total_balance is max(0, prepaid_balance + free_balance); prepaid_balance may be negative.
